title: The Good Samaritan
summaryZh: 耶穌指出屬靈的疾病比肉體更嚴重，我們都在罪的墮落之路上，需要基督拯救。
lines: And then there was a spiritual question, not only a social question, but a spiritual question.
接下來有一個屬靈的問題，不僅是一個社會的問題，而是一個屬靈的問題。
Throughout history, the church has shifted back and forth as to its emphasis on personal redemption and social involvement.
縱觀歷史，教會在強調個人救贖和社會參與之間搖擺不定。
They both go hand in hand.
But this man said, "Master, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?"
但這人說：「夫子！我該做什麼才可以承受永生？」
And the spiritual poverty of that man was deeper and worse than the material poverty.
而那個人在屬靈上的貧窮，比物質上的貧窮更深、更糟。
And Jesus showed that over and over again, that the spiritual disease is worse than the physical disease.
耶穌一再地表明，屬靈的疾病比身體的疾病更嚴重。
We can go out to Southeast Asia right now to Thailand, to some of those camps, and it'll break your heart.
我們現在可以去東南亞的泰國，去那些難民營看看，那會讓你心碎。
My son has been there several times and told me some of the most horrifying stories.
我兒子去過那裡好幾次，並告訴了我一些最駭人聽聞的故事。
We see it on our television screens and we say, "What can we do?"
我們在電視螢幕上看到這些，然後我們說：「我們能做什麼？」
We feel so helpless in a moment when people are suffering so terribly in so many parts of the world.
當世界各地有這麼多人正在遭受如此可怕的苦難時，我們感到非常無助。
這對我們來說太沉重了。
壓倒性的；令人不知所措的
We're to do what we can, they are our neighbors.
我們應該盡己所能，他們是我們的鄰舍。
But there's another disease, right here in Halifax, right here in Nova Scotia, that is worse than the diseases in those camps.
但還有另一種疾病，就在哈利法克斯，就在新斯科細亞省這裡，比那些難民營裡的疾病更嚴重。
It's the spiritual disease, the disease of sin.
這是屬靈的疾病，是罪的疾病。
It's worse than cancer because it destroys the soul.
它比癌症更糟，因為它會毀滅靈魂。
It destroys your relationship with God.
它會破壞你與神的關係。
It comes between you and peace, and joy, and happiness.
它阻礙了你獲得平安、喜樂和幸福。
You need to turn your life over to Christ and have this eternal life.
你需要將你的生命交託給基督，並得著這永生。
"What must I do to be saved?"
That's the same question that was asked Paul and Silas in prison.
這和保羅與西拉在監獄裡被問到的問題是一樣的。
And Paul said, "Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be saved."
保羅說：「當信主耶穌，你必得救。」
But it's not only a social and spiritual, but it's an individual problem.
但這不僅是一個社會和屬靈的問題，它也是一個個人的問題。
Now Jesus is interested in you as an individual.
耶穌對你這個個體很感興趣。
He sees the sparrow when it falls, He said,
祂說，當麻雀掉落地面時，祂看見了，
and He has the hairs of your head numbered, and He sees you as an individual.
祂連你們的頭髮也都被數過了，祂把你當作一個獨立的個體來看待。
"Greater love hath no man than this, that he lay down his life for his friends."
「人為朋友捨命，人的愛心沒有比這個大的。」
And the Scripture says this certain man in this story went down.
聖經說這個故事裡的『有一個人』下去了。
He went down from Jerusalem to Jericho.
他從耶路撒冷下耶利哥去。
Jericho was 800 feet below Jerusalem, about 18 miles away.
耶利哥在耶路撒冷下方八百英尺處，大約十八英里遠。
And a certain man went down the Jericho road.
有一個人沿著耶利哥的路下去。
Now Jerusalem was the place of the city of God; it was a city of peace at that time.
耶路撒冷是神的城；在當時，它是一座和平之城。
It was a city of truth, it was a city where the theologians were.
它是一座真理之城，是一座神學家所在的城市。
But now, he was going down.
That's the downward course of sin, and we're all on that downward Jericho road.
那就是罪的墮落之路，而我們都在那條向下走的耶利哥之路上。
And if you read the Scriptures and read the first chapter of Romans,
如果你讀聖經，讀到《羅馬書》第一章，
you'll find that sin starts in the very beginning and leads us downward, downward, downward, downward.
你會發現罪從一開始就發生，並將我們引向墮落、墮落、再墮落。
And like the shadow when it declined, said the Psalmist, "I am tossed down."
就像詩篇作者所說的：「我如日影偏斜而去，我被拋下。」
And this certain man was on his way down, like you are on your way down.
這個人正在往下走，就像你正在墮落的路上。
The president of the United Nations is right when he said,
聯合國大會主席說得對：
"We will never make war obsolete until we find a force that will bridle the passions of men and nations."
「在我們找到一種能夠約束人類與國家情慾的力量之前，我們永遠無法消除戰爭。」
Jesus Christ on that cross can transform the human life and change hate to love.
十字架上的耶穌基督能轉化人的生命，將仇恨化為愛。
"A certain man fell among thieves, and they stripped him of his raiment and wounded him."
「有一個人落在強盜手中，他們剝去他的衣裳，把他打傷了。」
And we have all fallen in with the devil and his demons.
我們也都落入了魔鬼和牠的邪靈手中。
And they've stripped us, they've wounded us, they've left us for dead.
牠們剝去了我們的衣裳，打傷了我們，把我們打個半死就撇下我們走了。
把...打個半死就丟下不管
